Reference image for the [[Jokes]] block on [[Don't Tread On Me]]: the Gadsden flag of 1775, a coiled rattlesnake above the words "DONT TREAD ON ME".

Source: [https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Gadsden_flag.svg Gadsden flag.svg], Wikimedia Commons, rendered at 960 pixels wide. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20260908022843/https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Gadsden_flag.svg Internet Archive], 8 September 2026.

License: Public domain (the flag was designed in 1775), as marked on Wikimedia Commons.
